title: Cagle’s Inshore Charters
specs: Fishing trips cover bay and 2 to 5 miles into Alabama’s Gulf Coast
Sightseeing includes dolphin encounters and views of Santa Rosa National Seashore, Fort Pickens, and Pensacola Lighthouse
Children are welcome on all charters
Max 6 fishermen per charter for fishing trips
Dolphin cruises for up to 6 passengers

options.name: Dolphin Cruise
options.detail: 6 passenger dolphin cruise including dolphin encounters, sightseeing, beach-combing, wine and cheese pairing, and sunset cruises

blurb: Offers inshore fishing charters 4-6 hours long aboard a 24' bay boat for up to 5 fishermen. Also offers dolphin and sightseeing cruises for up to 6 passengers along the Santa Rosa National Seashore and Gulf of Mexico. Trips include bait, fishing license, tackle, and ice; a first mate assists and cleans the catch.
extraNote: No cancellation penalty if cancelled outside 14 days prior to reservation · If cancelled within 7 days or no-show, charged remaining balance unless rebooked · Captain may cancel due to weather; full refund or reschedule offered · Weather cancellations may be made the day of the trip by the Captain only · Several launch points on the Gulf Coast of Alabama, including Gulf Shores
